editorial:
Imagine being a nice, honest teacher who just wants a date with a pretty girl, but your wallet is completely empty. That is exactly where you find Ovidiu in this funny and strange story. He lives in Bucharest and realizes that his teaching job doesn't pay nearly enough to keep up with the high cost of dating. To fix his money problems, he does something totally unexpected: he joins a professional gang of beggars. It is a wild ride that shows you a side of the city you would never see in a travel brochure, blending a bit of sadness with a lot of laughs.

You will love how the movie balances the comedy with the reality of poverty. The acting is great, and the way Ovidiu tries to apply his teacher logic to the world of street begging is hilarious. It moves along quickly, though some parts might feel a bit slow if you want a big action movie. If you are into smart comedies about the underdog, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: By the end, Ovidiu learns that the world of professional begging is more like a business than a charity. He makes a lot of money but loses his sense of who he is. He eventually realizes that cheating the system has a cost. He tries to balance his two lives, but the gap between the classroom and the street is too wide. He ends up understanding that true wealth isn't about the money he tricked people into giving him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky stories about regular people in weird situations.
